item.title: 🔒Private Home Surveillance w/ Frigate🔒
item.description:
When I recently adopted my first cat (her name is Fish 🐟), I wanted to keep an eye on her from work to see how she was adjusting. Naturally, a Home Surveillance system immediately came to mind; but I wanted something that goes above a typical home NVR system.

Companies like Amazon, Google, TP-Link, etc. offered systems with lots of interesting features like object detection, movement notifications, and face detetction. However, I tend to be pretty conscience of the data I create and where it all ends up going. It was important to me that the data didn’t end up on a server for one of the Big Tech companies because I dont know much about the terms related to what is happening with that data. Do I even own it?

On top of that major privacy concern, I wasn’t willing to pay any extra money on a subscription service for features (like object detection) the devices were built to use. After a bit of research I found Frigate NVR, which happened to check all of my boxes and more!

Cover Photo blurred for protection of my location.
